headline: Singapore Survey Shows 75% of Employers Deploy AI for HR Functions
summary: Nearly 75 percent of Singapore employers utilize artificial intelligence for human resources functions, though 85 percent still require human confirmation, a SNEF survey shows.
why: Singapore serves as a primary tech and corporate hub in Southeast Asia; corporate adoption rates for AI reflect broader workforce productivity shifts.

impacts.name: Enterprise Software
impacts.why: High corporate adoption of HR automation drives continued software demand.
